name: Floating Pill Navbar
description: A black floating pill nav with a sliding hover highlight that tucks itself in on scroll, plus a full-screen cobalt menu sheet on mobile.

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark beside the logo mark. Folds away when the bar tucks in.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; count?: string }[]
props.description: Nav links. count renders as a small mono superscript.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Link for the current page: pink dot and aria-current="page".

props.name: cta
props.description: Pink pill on the right (desktop) and the bottom of the mobile sheet.

props.name: contact
props.type: { email: string; phone: string; address: string[] }
props.description: Contact details shown in the mobile sheet.

props.name: socials
props.description: Text links at the foot of the mobile sheet.

props.name: condenseAt
props.description: Scroll distance in px after which the pill narrows and drops its wordmark.
